game_concept: A action defense set in Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope, a slope primed for avalanche: the rescue climber must handle ice hawks while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Case Choir: Convert text with upper(), lower(), and title() to match the choir's tune.
theme: Frost Peaks – Avalanche Slope: a slope primed for avalanche
core_gameplay_loop: In Avalanche Slope, repeat each round: Convert text with upper(), lower(), and title() to match the choir's tune. Each round, ice hawks strike the rescue sled, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the choir value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rescue sled from ice hawks in Avalanche Slope: keep the choir meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: choir drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 5 (applied tier): Case Choir
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Case Choir' (Week 8 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Avalanche Slope'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how choir changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ice hawks in Avalanche Slope.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while choir > 0.
